facts.fact: The Système d'échange national (SEN), run by the Unité de gouvernance digitale, already interconnects 14 institutions and supports services including Orinasa, Lucy, Hetra Online, the RNCS and the SRNE, per the 2424.mg report of the April 2026 launch.
14 institutions are connected to the Système d'échange national, according to 2424.mg.
The Programme de réformes pour l'efficacité de l'administration (PREA) reports more than 162,000 exchanges recorded through the SEN to date.

MDG.note: Services are named as supported by the exchange system, but the document states no count and no online application or payment by citizens.
The document says nothing on checks against the national ID.
An exchange platform is described; no interoperability framework is stated.
No law or decree on data sharing is stated.
